scope.description: 24 explicitly synthetic, developer-authored Malay, English and mixed reports. Labels and synthetic replies are provisional author annotations, not expert or participant data.
scope.trainingUse: Do not use for training or claim an independent holdout. This disclosed fixture tests mechanisms and known edge cases; obtain fresh independently annotated reports for final claims.
scope.locationScope: Fixture catalogue combines approved legacy zones and two real DJM post identifiers. LG aliases are synthetic ambiguity stressors; no coordinates or real incident locations are asserted.

runtime.interpretation: Hybrid metrics combine contextual rules and saved-model inference; they are not accuracy results for the trained model alone.

clarification.interpretation: After scores use additional explicitly supplied synthetic user facts and changed gold labels. They do not measure improved extraction of the original text or human benefit.

questionBurden.limitation: Question counts and synthetic answer replay are structural measurements; no participant time, satisfaction or usability data.

limitations: Synthetic developer-authored regression set; expected labels are provisional, not expert-adjudicated.
Report category uses the same report-level hybrid projection for both reportHybrid and eventDialogue; do not claim a separate classifier improvement from that comparison.
Singleton legacy adapters expose their actual lack of event segmentation; keyword status=reported is its occurrence assumption and field output is empty.
Source-overlap matching ignores category/status when pairing events. Event recall and joint F1 include omissions; extra events count as false positives.
Gemini import is optional. Missing predictions are not zero scores. Partial imports are compared only with the same local subset.
Unknown preservation and unsupported location counts assess annotated catalogue identity; source spans alone cannot establish factual truth.
No operational, expert or participant records were collected by this script. No network or provider calls occur.
